text:
maria: Quick heads-up — proposing a nightshift shadow unpin of runtime v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 in the 01:00-03:00 UTC change window. Aim is to verify unpinned traffic routing and SDK compatibility before wider rollouts.
jonathan: do we have a verified rollback path if memory regressions show up?
maria: yes — rollback plan is tagged in the runbook and deploy-bot can rollback to v3.2.1 within 5m. main risk: longseq tails under quantized kernels.
nina: SRE ack in principle. need to confirm canary footprint: 3% traffic, EU + us-west, and KV cache warmup metric checks. I want the telemetry asserts listed here.
maria: added telemetry asserts to the PR — cpu/mem p50/p95, kvcache hit rate, OOM count, and end-to-end latency for 64/512 seq.
kai: SDK note — clientlib 2.14.0 has a minor compat change for token streaming handshake. we tested against 3.3.0 locally, works but we need a rollout note so integrators know to update if using streaming edge-case flags.
maria: thanks. can you add a short blurb for the release notes (1-2 lines)?
kai: added: "SDK: optional streaming handshake bump — no forced upgrade for typical users; update recommended for streaming-heavy clients."
adele: QA: will run the shadow harness tomorrow 22:00 UTC against devnet. Test plan: regression prompts, long-seq 2k, concurrency 120, and model fallback verification. leaving a checklist in the PR.
maria: deploy-bot, can you schedule the shadow deploy at 01:15 UTC with canary=3% and a 30m observation gate?
deploy-bot: scheduling job: shadow-unpin-3123456790 at 01:15 UTC. canary=3%, regions=eu-west-1,us-west-2, observation_window=30m. command: /deploy shadow-unpin runtime=v3.3.0 canary=3% --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2 --observe 30m
jonathan: add a hard abort condition: if kvcache-hit drops >5pp or p95 latency increases >30% or OOM >0 in any canary instance, we abort and rollback immediately.
maria: added those as automations in the deploy job. also tagging "safemode=on" so fallback routing to runtime v3.2.1 is automatic on trigger.
nina: I'll be oncall during window and will monitor. if we see memory creep, immediate rollback.
kai: one more SDK note — clients using the legacy streaming flag need to set streaming_compat=true for now, otherwise they might see truncated chunks in rare cases. putting that in the release note.
adele: QA will post a short regression summary in this thread after the 22:00 run.
maria: thanks everyone. final checklist before deploy: 1) QA run green, 2) telemetry asserts wired, 3) deploy-bot scheduled (done), 4) SRE oncall ack (nina), 5) SDK blurb in release notes (kai). If all green, we proceed with shadow.
jonathan: one last ask — make sure customer-facing release notes call out that this is a shadow unpin and only affects routed canary traffic, not all users.
maria: will do. copying release note snippet here:
Release notes (short):
- Runtime: shadow unpin v3.3.0 (canary 3%) — improves inference kernels and long-seq stability.
- SDK: optional streaming handshake bump (2.14.0) — recommended for streaming-heavy clients; no mandatory upgrade.
- Known issue: legacy streaming flag may require streaming_compat=true to avoid truncated chunks in rare cases.
adele: QA: devnet harness green. will post artifacts and perf numbers in #eng-platform after ingest.
maria: perfect. leaving this thread open for any late friction. thanks :thumbsup:
